mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stock_watch_fact_observation (symbol, market, stock_name, observation_key, arrival_version, source_time_epoch_ms, source_date, source_time_quality, fact_hash, fact_snapshot_json, data_quality_json, sampled_at) VALUES (#{symbol}, #{market}, #{stockName}, #{observationKey}, #{arrivalVersion}, #{sourceTimeEpochMs}, #{sourceDate}, #{sourceTimeQuality}, #{factHash}, #{factSnapshotJson}, #{dataQualityJson}, #{sampledAt})
mapper.select: SELECT MIN(source_date) FROM stock_watch_fact_observation WHERE source_date > #{sourceDate} AND source_time_quality IN ('FRESH', 'POST_CLOSE_VALID')
